title: Leveraging AI for Direct Bystander Intervention Against Cyberbullying

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating human bystander intervention rates (supportive and resisting frequencies) in response to simulated cyberbullying posts and comments targeting physical appearance, clothing, and weight.
Measuring the frequency of bystander interventions against cyberbullying comments that target gender roles and expectations (e.g., women in STEM, men getting manicures).
Assessing bystander intervention behaviors when exposed to homophobic cyberbullying comments targeting a simulated post about an LGBTQ+ pride parade.
Measuring bystander intervention rates against cyberbullying comments containing racial slurs, stereotypes, and xenophobic remarks directed at Asian, African, and Indian individuals.
